title: Balanced Haloumi Noodle Salad
subtitle: with Japanese Dressing and Sticky Almonds
description: Haloumi and almonds pan-fried in honey are the stars of this sublime noodle salad. With a moreish Japanese dressing and pickled veggies for crunch, it's satisfying and utterly delicious.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Halve the cucumber lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Shred the carrot using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.
Pickle veggies: Put 2 tsp white vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the cucumber and carrot and toss to coat. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold water to prevent the noodles from sticking (see Kitchen 101). Meanwhile, put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Pan-fry haloumi: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until browned. Add the almonds, 1 tsp honey and 2 tsp water and bring to the boil. Cook, turning the haloumi regularly, for 30 secs or until the liquid has evaporated. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Add the noodles, salad leaves and Japanese dressing to the pickled veggies and toss to coat. Divide the noodle salad among bowls, top with the haloumi and almonds and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Rinsing the noodles helps to prevent them sticking together by removing some of the starch. To stop them clumping after rinsing, lightly drizzle the noodles with oil and toss to coat, if desired.
